purpose: One limited local fresh-input audit of quiet shared omissions; stop at evidence gate if inadequate
selection: Seeded hash,2newspapers+2academic articles,one page per distinct filename-derived source group; excludes all previously local original-image names and recorded sample groups; no selection by new OCR result
independence: New relative to prior local inspected/selected sources, not model-training holdout; source document grouping is a filename proxy, not publisher-verified
line_annotation: Construct physical line groups from body text_span polygons; inspect each source page/annotation overlay before treating them as line-level truth; inline formulas and short markers separate
configuration_caveat: Three configurations of one framework, not three independent OCR models. No independent-model generalization claim.

common_settings.input: identical original pixels, orientation.up, no rescaling/binarization/cropping for primary pass
common_settings.execution: serial; BLAS/OpenCV2threads if used; Vision internal scheduling not exposed

completion: Save one result or explicit error per image/configuration, monotonic times, requested and actual revision, image dimensions and source hashes, request-returned completion status; no generative token stop reason applies to this API

data_gate.whole_line_or_region: at least5visually confirmed source line omissions shared by>=2configurations across>=2document groups; report all3-shared subset
data_gate.short_markers: separate task; at least5confirmed positions across>=2documents, with any successful third configuration as baseline
data_gate.insufficient: Do not expand or force next phase; report missing or unsupported labels, API errors and unrun metrics

stage2: Only if data gate is met, freeze call/pixel budget and candidate rule before detector/local OCR; compare ordinary detection+reread and available confidence/configuration-disagreement controls. Record correct recovery, false insertion and harm. Ground-truth boxes only for evaluation or separately named oracle.
data_limits: No renting GPUs, paid calls, training or model downloads; only4public source images may be fetched, no source resampling after outputs
release_note: Sanitized derivative; protocol_sha256 in run.json refers to frozen private original. Image and source identifiers withheld. Code requires private inputs and is not a self-contained data release.
